30.description: Restaurante Peixarada, on Largo da Barca in Portimão, allows dogs indoors provided they are not large. Specialising in fish and seafood, it serves dishes such as grilled fish, cod and seafood rice. If you have a large dog, contact the restaurant before visiting to confirm whether it can be accommodated.

32.description: Xarme Restaurante & Bar in Portimão welcomes only small, quiet dogs indoors. Dogs of any size are allowed on the outdoor terrace. The restaurant serves international dishes and has a bar atmosphere, with regular events and live music. Choose the terrace if your dog is larger or may be noisy.

34.description: Roots Aljezur, on Rua 25 de Abril in Aljezur, is a café and restaurant welcoming dogs indoors. Its fully vegan menu focuses on fresh, healthy food such as sweet potato waffles, açaí and granola bowls, seasonal soups, salads, sugar-free cakes and gluten-free choices. It is a useful place for breakfast, brunch or lunch with your dog in central Aljezur.

35.description: Amunì Caffè, near Praia da Rocha in Portimão, allows dogs indoors. Inspired by Sicily, the café serves coffee, brunch and ice cream. It is a convenient stop with your dog near the beach; keep your pet close so that people can move comfortably through the indoor space.

36.description: Pizzaria Acqua e Sale in Tavira welcomes dogs indoors and usually offers them water and biscuits. The restaurant specialises in Italian cuisine, including pizzas, pasta and freshly made pasta dishes. It is a welcoming option for lunch or dinner with your dog in Tavira.

37.description: Restaurante A Ponte, beside the waterfront in Portimão, welcomes dogs of any size both indoors and on its terrace. Its menu features Portuguese cooking and fish, with buffet and rodízio service on selected occasions. It is an easy option for a meal by the river with your dog.

39.description: OK Burger, on Rua Alexandre Herculano in Areias de São João, Albufeira, welcomes dogs of any size on its terrace, with water and sometimes a treat available for them. It specialises in freshly prepared smash burgers made with Angus beef, brioche buns and toppings such as cheddar, bacon, pickles and house sauces. A vegetarian alternative is also available. Dogs are not permitted indoors.

40.description: Restaurante Encci in Carvoeiro, near Lagoa, welcomes dogs both indoors and outside as long as they are accompanied and kept on a lead. Its daytime menu includes brunch, bowls, fresh juices and coffee, while pizzas are a focus later in the day. Vegan and gluten-free options are also available. A convenient choice for breakfast, lunch or dinner with your dog in Carvoeiro.

41.description: Praia Fluvial de Alte, near Fonte Grande in Alte, in the municipality of Loulé, is a riverside leisure area where dogs may accompany their owners on a lead. The site has a natural swimming pool, picnic areas, shade and spaces for relaxing beside Ribeira de Alte. Dogs are not allowed in the pool or spring, or within the spring’s protected perimeter. Respect the posted rules when visiting this inland Algarve attraction with your dog.

47.description: Restaurante Botânico in Ferrarias, Almancil, welcomes well-behaved dogs indoors and provides water for them. Its contemporary menu includes meat, fish, vegan and gluten-free options, served in a setting surrounded by greenery. It is a pleasant choice for lunch or dinner with your dog near Almancil and Quinta do Lago, provided your pet remains calm during the meal.

52.description: The Passadiços de Alvor boardwalks, near Portimão, offer an approximately six-kilometre, mostly flat route through the estuary, dunes and coastal landscape. Dogs can accompany walkers, but keeping them on a lead and remaining on the boardwalk are recommended to protect the ecosystem. There is little shade and the route can be busy on sunny days, so cooler hours are best.

53.description: Parque Canino de Olhão in Quelfes, in the municipality of Olhão, is a fenced dog park where dogs can run and play safely off-lead. The enclosure has a drinking fountain, benches and obstacles for activity and training. It is a useful place for exercise and socialisation with your dog in the eastern Algarve.

55.description: Gaia Organic Shop & Kitchen in Rogil, near Aljezur, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and in its spacious garden, provided they stay on a lead. Water is available for pets. The venue combines an organic grocery shop with plant-based food in a relaxed, nature-inspired atmosphere. It is a convenient stop for eating, shopping or spending time with your dog along the Vicentine Coast.

56.description: Forum Algarve in Faro allows dogs in its common areas on a short lead. Dogs cannot enter the food court or hypermarket, and individual shops may apply their own rules. Outside, a dog-friendly area has drinking water, a dog toilet and play equipment, which should be used under supervision. Leads and muzzles can also be borrowed from the information desk against a deposit. It is a useful place to shop with your dog in Faro.

69.description: Churrasqueira Cruz de Portugal in Silves welcomes up to two dogs inside and also has an outdoor terrace. The restaurant specialises in Portuguese grilled food, including roast chicken and other dishes from the grill. The indoor dog policy is displayed at the entrance.

70.description: Aqua Portimão is a dog-friendly shopping centre in Portimão where dogs may walk on a lead in the common areas. They are not allowed in the food court or supermarket, and only certain shops permit dogs inside. Check the signs at each shop before entering with your pet.

73.description: The Flower Bar – Healthy Kitchen, on Rua Ataíde de Oliveira in Faro, welcomes dogs indoors provided they stay on a lead. Combining a café serving light, healthy food with a shop selling Portuguese handmade goods, flowers and home décor, it is a distinctive place for breakfast, lunch or a coffee break with your dog in Faro.

74.description: MAR Shopping Algarve in Almancil, near Loulé, allows dogs in the shopping centre’s common areas when accompanied by their owners. Dogs are not permitted in the food court or supermarket, and participating shops display signs indicating that pets may enter. The centre also has Woofland, a supervised dog-care area. Check each shop’s rules before entering with your dog.

84.description: Parque Canino da Quinta do Caneco in Portimão is a fenced dog park where dogs can run and play off-lead. Always supervise your dog while using the enclosure.

93.description: 5 Emotions in Portimão offers dog-friendly boat trips departing from Portimão Marina. Dogs are welcome on board without an extra charge; guests only need to let the operator know in advance that they will bring a dog. Excursions explore the Algarve coastline, including the Benagil caves and dolphin-watching trips. It is an appealing way to experience the coast with your dog.

100.description: Blue Ocean Trips, at Portimão Marina, allows dogs aboard its boat excursions along the Algarve coast. Trips include visits to the Benagil caves and sunset cruises. Confirm your chosen route and the onboard arrangements for your dog with the operator before booking.

106.description: Ato Restaurante, on Rua do Albergue in Faro’s historic centre, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and has no terrace. Because the restaurant is small, guests are advised to give advance notice; admission depends on the dog’s behaviour and available space. Its contemporary cooking draws on seasonal Algarve ingredients. It is a distinctive option for dining with your dog in the heart of Faro.

108.description: Lemon Drops, at Albufeira Marina, welcomes dogs of any size both indoors and on the terrace. Its menu includes breakfast, light meals, salads, hummus, vegetarian and vegan dishes, fish, seafood and traditional Algarve cataplana. Overlooking the marina, it is a relaxed place to enjoy breakfast, lunch, dinner or a break with your dog in Albufeira.

109.description: Allboat, based at Albufeira Marina, allows dogs on its rigid inflatable boat excursions, with a maximum weight of 20 kg for safety and space reasons. Each dog is charged the equivalent of a child’s ticket. The trips explore the Albufeira coastline, caves and beaches, with dolphin watching included on some excursions. It offers an opportunity to discover the Algarve coast with a smaller dog.

113.description: Capitão Nemo Algarve, departing from Parchal, allows dogs on its boat trips subject to advance confirmation. Acceptance depends on the dog’s size, available space and passenger numbers. Larger dogs must be discussed before booking and, if they occupy a seat, may be charged a child fare, particularly from May to September. Dogs should be sociable because there is a resident mascot on board. Trips include dolphin watching, Benagil caves, the Lagos coast and the Arade River.

120.description: Don Gull in Lagos welcomes up to four dogs in its indoor dining area and on the terrace. The restaurant serves creative fusion cuisine, sharing plates, meat and fish dishes, wines and cocktails. With both indoor and outdoor seating, it is a convenient choice for lunch or dinner with your dog in Lagos, subject to the four-dog limit.

124.description: Tony’s Pizza, at Quinta Shopping in Almancil, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace, with water and biscuits available for pets. The restaurant serves Italian dishes including freshly prepared pizzas, pasta, risotto, salads and desserts, along with breakfast options. Its informal, family-friendly setting makes it an easy choice for eating with your dog near Quinta do Lago.

125.description: Aldeia da Pedralva by WOT Signature, in the municipality of Vila do Bispo, offers dog-friendly accommodation in a restored village on the Vicentine Coast. Pets must be trained and accompanied and kept on a lead in shared areas, although they can be off-lead inside the guest room. A €25 daily pet fee and a €100 refundable security deposit apply, subject to any damage. It is a scenic base for exploring the western Algarve with your dog.

128.description: WOT Lagos Montemar Soul, on Rua da Torraltinha in Lagos, accepts dogs and cats, with a maximum of two pets per room. The fee is €15 per pet per day, plus a refundable €100 deposit if no damage occurs. Pets must be supervised or in a carrier and kept on a lead in shared areas. They are not allowed in restaurants, bars, spas or swimming pools and cannot be left alone overnight. It is an accommodation option near central Lagos and its beaches for guests travelling with pets.

139.description: Fábrica dos Óculos Lagos, on Rua dos Celeiros in Lagos, allows dogs inside its optical shop. The store offers optician and optometry services, prescription glasses, frames and sunglasses. It is a useful place to shop for eyewear or attend to your vision needs while your dog accompanies you indoors.

140.description: Villa Pedras del Rei in Santa Luzia, near Tavira, is dog-friendly accommodation accepting two to three dogs per stay without size restrictions. Dogs may stay inside and share the bedroom with their owners. A €350 security deposit is required per booking. Near Barril Beach and the Ria Formosa lagoon, it is a practical base for a holiday with dogs in the eastern Algarve.

145.description: Quinta dos Capinhas in Porches, near Lagoa, welcomes dogs on its vineyard visits and wine-tasting experiences. Dogs must stay on a lead, and owners are responsible for keeping the property clean and safe. This family-run Algarve winery offers tastings, vineyard walks, picnics and buggy safaris. Visits are by advance booking, so confirm the arrangements for bringing your dog when reserving.

156.description: Cape Cruiser, departing from Porto da Baleeira in Sagres, accepts small and medium-sized dogs on its dolphin- and whale-watching boat trips. Whether a dog can board depends on passenger numbers, sea conditions and safety requirements. Confirm your dog’s acceptance when booking so the operator can assess the conditions for your trip.

169.description: Parque Ribeirinho de Silves is a free riverside park beside the Arade River in Silves, with green spaces, a cycle path, a playground and a sports area. It is a pleasant place to walk your dog on a lead, with open space and water available. Keep your dog supervised and always clean up after it.

170.description: Vale Luís Neto – Retiro do Caldeirão in Salir, near Loulé, accepts up to three dogs of any size with no extra pet fee. Dogs cannot stay inside the bedrooms, but each of the three holiday houses has a private patio or garden where they can remain. Surrounded by the countryside of the Serra do Caldeirão, it is a peaceful accommodation option for visitors travelling with dogs in inland Algarve.

173.description: Moinho da Alma in Porches, in the municipality of Lagoa, welcomes dogs in its accommodation without size restrictions, a stated limit on the number of dogs or an additional pet fee. Dogs may stay in the room but should not climb on beds or sofas; guests whose pets are used to doing so should bring protective covers. Owners must clean up after their dogs, respect other guests and take responsibility for damage. It is a flexible dog-friendly base for exploring the Algarve.

175.description: The western end of Praia de Alvor, in the municipality of Portimão, is a wide, non-concession beach area suitable for walks with your dog beside the sea. Rules may vary during the bathing season, so always check local signage before entering with a dog. Keep your pet supervised and clean up after it.

181.description: Praia da Angrinha in Ferragudo, in the municipality of Lagoa, is a non-concession beach beside the Arade River estuary where visitors may bring dogs unless local signs say otherwise. The beach is near Forte de São João do Arade and Ferragudo’s traditional fishing area. It is a pleasant place for a waterside walk with your dog, provided you follow the posted rules, supervise your pet and clean up after it.

193.description: Dungle Club, on Estrada das Pereiras in Quarteira, is a social space for dogs and their people. Its fenced area lets dogs run, play and socialise safely off-lead, while owners can relax in the lounge, bar and coffee area. The venue also offers dog washing, grooming, events and activities, with water available for dogs. Check opening times, entry rules and conditions before visiting.

203.description: My’oMeu, on Rua Conselheiro Sebastião Teles in central Faro, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. Due to the small dining room, only small dogs are accepted inside, while dogs of all sizes are welcome outdoors. The restaurant combines Polish and Mediterranean cooking, including pierogi, freshly made pasta, seasonal dishes and vegetarian options. It is an inviting place for lunch or dinner with your dog in Faro.

204.description: Bel’mare, at Praia de Faro, welcomes calm, well-behaved dogs of any size indoors and outside, with water available for pets. Facing the Atlantic, it combines a restaurant, bar and rooftop. Its menu includes fish, seafood, meat, poke bowls and sharing dishes. The venue also operates a beach concession with food and drink service, making it a convenient stop with your dog by the sea in Faro.

205.description: Sal’mare, at Praia de Faro, welcomes calm, well-behaved dogs of any size both indoors and on its terrace. Water is available for pets. During the day it has a relaxed beach-club atmosphere, while in the evening it becomes a steakhouse focused on premium cuts of meat. With a terrace beside the sand, it is easy to combine a meal with a walk along Faro Beach with your dog.

206.description: Spot Local in Moncarapacho is both a café and accommodation welcoming well-behaved pets, subject to advance arrangement. Animals are permitted in the café and guest rooms but must stay on a lead in the café and while exploring the grounds. A fee of €20 per pet per night applies. It is a useful pet-friendly option for a coffee or an overnight stay in the eastern Algarve.

211.description: Toska Hamburgueria, on Rua João Augusto Saias in Olhão, welcomes dogs on its terrace, where water is available. Known for its handmade burgers, it also offers wraps, bruschetta, salads, bowls and vegetarian and vegan choices. It is an informal place for a relaxed meal with your dog in Olhão.

212.description: Tavira Plaza is a shopping centre in Tavira where dogs are welcome indoors when accompanied and kept on a non-retractable lead no longer than one metre. The centre has shops, food outlets and services, making it possible to run errands with your dog. Dogs classified as potentially dangerous must also comply with the legal muzzle requirements. It is particularly useful on hot or rainy days.

215.description: Hola Torito, on Avenida 5 de Outubro in Olhão, is a Mexican restaurant welcoming dogs on its terrace. Water is available for pets, which must remain on a lead. The menu includes tacos, nachos, guacamole, burritos and other Mexican favourites, along with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. A lively choice for lunch or dinner with your dog in central Olhão.

216.description: NATSU Tavira, on Travessa José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace as long as they remain on a lead. The Japanese-inspired menu goes beyond sushi, with ramen, yakisoba, gyoza, bao buns, donburi, vegetarian options and Asian-style desserts. Its central location makes it an easy place to combine a walk through Tavira with a meal outside alongside your dog.

217.description: Primitivo Tavira, on Praça Dr. António Padinha in central Tavira, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. Dogs must remain on a lead, and water is available. Fire is central to the restaurant’s cooking, with grilled meat, fish, seafood and vegetarian dishes on a seasonal menu. It is a distinctive place for lunch or dinner with your dog in Tavira.

219.description: Quiosque da Alfarrobeira, in Parque Urbano da Alfarrobeira in Albufeira, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace, with water available for pets. Surrounded by walking paths, lawns and recreational areas, the kiosk-bar is a handy place for a drink or a break during a walk with your dog. There is also a fenced dog park nearby.

220.description: Parque Canino da Alfarrobeira, within Parque Urbano da Alfarrobeira in central Albufeira, is a fenced dog area where dogs can run and play off-lead. The enclosure has exercise obstacles, open space, shade and benches for owners. Entry is free. The wider urban park also offers walking paths, a fitness area, a playground, picnic facilities and a bar. It is a practical place for off-lead exercise and socialisation in Albufeira.

221.description: Frente ao Mar, on Rua Mascarenhas Gregório in Armação de Pêra, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace. The café and bar serves breakfast, brunch, lunch and drinks, with burgers, salads, sandwiches, crêpes and ice cream among the options. Its spacious, shady terrace makes it a convenient stop with your dog close to the seafront.

224.description: Sambé Beach, at Praia de Santo António in Vila Real de Santo António, allows dogs on its outdoor terrace. The beach restaurant and bar is a place to enjoy a meal, a drink or a break close to the sand with your dog beside you. It offers an easy option for dog owners exploring this part of the eastern Algarve.

225.description: Originato, on Rua José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs indoors provided they remain on a lead. Close to the river and the ferry departure point for Tavira Island, the café serves breakfast, brunch and light meals, including bagels, pancakes, bowls, eggs, smoothies and coffee. It is a convenient stop with your dog before or after exploring Tavira’s historic centre and riverside.

226.description: Daiya Sushi Tavira, at Fábrica Balsense in Tavira, welcomes dogs both indoors and outside. Alongside sushi, the restaurant offers contemporary Asian dishes, hot meals, creative combinations, cocktails and sharing plates. Its terrace is inviting on warm days, while indoor seating makes it an option throughout the year. A useful dog-friendly choice for lunch or dinner in Tavira.

228.description: Antisocial, in Guia near Albufeira, welcomes dogs indoors. Describing itself as a concept rather than simply a brunch spot or coffee shop, it serves focaccia sandwiches, house-made pastries and speciality coffee in a laid-back setting. It is an appealing choice for a meal or coffee with your dog in Guia, without needing to sit outside.

229.description: Café Formosa, on Rua José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs indoors. Specialising in speciality coffee, it also serves breakfast and light lunches, including focaccia, pastries, fresh juices and matcha, with vegan options available. It is a relaxed place for coffee or a bite to eat with your dog near Tavira’s historic centre.

241.description: Old Times Bistro, Bar & Coffee in Manta Rota, in the municipality of Vila Real de Santo António, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. Offering café, bar and restaurant service, it is a convenient place for breakfast, a meal or a drink with your dog. You can choose between indoor and outdoor seating when visiting Manta Rota.

249.description: Abigail’s Café in Lagos is a café and bakery welcoming well-behaved, sociable dogs indoors. It serves breakfast, brunch, lunch and speciality coffee, focusing on homemade food and locally sourced ingredients whenever possible. The menu includes juices, smoothies, and vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free choices. It is a good option for a light, relaxed meal with your dog in central Lagos.

255.description: AREL – Padaria & Cozinha in Aljezur welcomes dogs indoors. Located on Rua 25 de Abril, it combines an artisan bakery with a kitchen, serving sourdough bread, pastries and food throughout the day. It is a handy stop for breakfast, lunch or coffee with your dog in the centre of the village, especially for visitors exploring Aljezur and the Vicentine Coast.

256.description: Salema Tours, based at Salema Beach in the municipality of Vila do Bispo, allows dogs on boat trips when sea conditions permit. The company offers dolphin-watching trips, visits to coastal caves and Benagil Cave, fishing excursions and kayak hire. If taking a dog aboard is not advisable, the animal may be left ashore in the care of the animal-loving team while its owners enjoy the trip. This offers a distinctive way to explore the Algarve coast without leaving your dog out of the experience.

269.description: Belém – Brunch Bar in Tavira welcomes small and medium-sized dogs both indoors and on the terrace. The all-day concept combines brunch, coffee and cocktails, with options for breakfast, lunch or a relaxed break. Being able to choose between indoor and outdoor seating makes it a practical place to eat with your dog in Tavira, Algarve.

271.description: Earth Shop & Café in Carvoeiro, in the municipality of Lagoa, welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace, with a maximum of three animals. If a dog barks indoors, staff may ask that it stay outside. Overlooking the sea, the café and shop serves breakfast and brunch throughout the day, including bowls, wraps, salads, smoothies and coffee. It is a convenient dog-friendly spot for breakfast or lunch in central Carvoeiro.

284.description: Parque Canino de Quarteira, in the municipality of Loulé, is a fenced dog park where dogs can run freely in a safe enclosure. Opened in May 2026 and located beside the Continente supermarket, it has equipment, areas for spending time with dogs and signs explaining the rules. It is a practical off-leash option in Quarteira where dogs can run, play and socialise in a purpose-built space, with easy access during a walk around town.

298.description: Zénite Rooftop Bar at Kimpton Atlântico Algarve in Albufeira welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace, provided they stay on a lead. Water is available for pets. With panoramic Atlantic views, the rooftop offers signature cocktails, music and Peruvian- and Nikkei-inspired food, making it especially appealing in the late afternoon and at sunset. It is a relaxed place for a drink or light bite with your dog near the sea in Albufeira.

299.description: NAU São Rafael Suites in Albufeira is a five-star dog-friendly hotel accepting pets weighing up to 15 kg, with a maximum of one pet per room. Dogs may stay in family rooms and access permitted hotel areas but must be kept on a lead. There is an extra charge of €25 per night and a €100 deposit is required at check-in. The hotel provides a bed, bowl, water and a small surprise for your pet. With spacious outdoor areas and a location near São Rafael Beach, it is a comfortable option for an Algarve holiday with your dog.

300.description: Tascaria São Rafael in Albufeira is a dog-friendly restaurant at NAU São Rafael Suites, where dogs are welcome indoors. They must remain on a lead, and water is available for them. The restaurant is also open to guests who are not staying at the hotel and serves traditional Portuguese cuisine featuring local produce and regional flavours. It is a pleasant option for dinner with your dog in Albufeira, in a smart setting near São Rafael and Sesmarias beaches.

301.description: Kimpton Atlântico Algarve in Albufeira is a dog-friendly hotel welcoming dogs of any size or breed, with no limit on the number of pets and no additional fee or deposit. Pets may stay in rooms and access communal areas, terraces and outdoor spaces; the Wellness Hub Atlântico is the only restricted area. On request, the hotel provides a pet bed, food and water bowls, treats, toys and waste bags. It is a particularly flexible choice for staying with dogs in the Algarve without size restrictions or extra pet charges.

303.description: Altentica Pizzaria in Ferreiras, Albufeira, welcomes dogs on its terrace, where water is available for pets. Dogs must remain on a lead. The restaurant specialises in freshly made pizza and pasta, with vegetarian and gluten-free options too. Its informal, family-friendly outdoor seating makes it a convenient choice for dinner with your dog in the Ferreiras area.

305.description: The Westin Salgados Beach Resort in Albufeira welcomes dogs and cats weighing up to 10 kg, with a maximum of one pet per room. There is an additional charge of €17 per night. Pets may stay in the room, have water available and must be kept on a lead in permitted areas. Located between Salgados Beach and the lagoon in the Salgados Nature Reserve, the resort offers extensive outdoor spaces, pools, a spa and several restaurants for an Algarve holiday with your pet.

307.description: Nosolo Itália in Portimão, on Praça Manuel Teixeira Gomes, allows dogs on the terrace, so you can enjoy a meal together in the city centre. This is where the Nosolo Italia concept began, and the extensive Italian-inspired menu includes pizza, pasta, salads, meat, fish, crêpes, waffles and its well-known handmade ice cream. It's a practical place for lunch, dinner or an ice cream with your dog near Portimão's waterfront.

320.description: Penha Longa Resort in Linhó, near Sintra, accepts pets weighing up to 25 kg in selected accommodation, including certain Garden Wing suites and apartments, for an additional fee. Surrounded by the Sintra hills, the resort offers gardens, walking paths, golf, a spa and restaurants. Pet access depends on room type and availability, so mention your dog when booking and confirm the current fee and permitted areas.

321.description: Quinta de São Tadeu in Galamares, near Sintra, accepts pets on request, with an indicated supplement of €10 per pet per night, subject to the chosen room’s conditions. Set in a restored 250-year-old manor house with gardens and a terrace, it offers a peaceful place to stay with your dog near Monserrate and Sintra’s historic centre. Confirm availability and pet arrangements before booking.

322.description: NH Sintra Centro, close to Sintra’s historic centre, welcomes dogs and cats, up to a maximum of two animals per room. A fee of €25 per pet per night applies, and guests must contact the hotel before arrival and present a valid vaccination record at check-in. Guide dogs are exempt from the fee. Its central location makes it a practical base for visiting Sintra with your dog.

354.description: Pavilhão do Conhecimento – Ciência Viva, in Parque das Nações, Lisbon, welcomes pets throughout the year under specific entry rules. Before visiting, register at the ticket office with the owner’s identification, an up-to-date pet health record or passport and proof of microchipping. A free PATAporte is then issued, valid for one year. Dogs must use a non-retractable lead of no more than one metre and a muzzle where legally required. They may enter the foyer, exhibitions and common areas, but not the café interior or Casa Inacabada. Limits are two pets per person and four per group; water and waste bags are available outside.

356.description: Café Kapheina in São Bartolomeu de Messines, in the municipality of Silves, welcomes dogs on the terrace and provides water for them. Located in the centre of the village, it is a handy place to stop for coffee, breakfast or a light meal with your dog at an outdoor table. The terrace and available water make visits more comfortable, whether you're walking around Messines or stopping on a journey through inland Algarve.

357.description: The Therapist Alvalade, on Rua José d’Esaguy in Lisbon, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace and provides water for them. The restaurant focuses on natural, mindful eating, with mainly vegetarian and vegan dishes alongside some fish options, using seasonal and local ingredients where possible. It is an attractive spot for breakfast, lunch or a light meal with your dog in Alvalade.

358.description: Gal Café, in the Anjos neighbourhood of Lisbon, is a vegan café welcoming dogs indoors and providing water for them. Its entirely plant-based menu includes breakfast, brunch, pancakes, croissants, sandwiches, bowls, cakes, smoothies and speciality coffee, with some Brazilian influences. Food, music and small art exhibitions create an informal neighbourhood atmosphere where you can relax with your dog inside.

359.description: A Minha Avó, on Avenida António Augusto de Aguiar in Lisbon, is a vegan restaurant welcoming dogs indoors, with water available for them. Its plant-based menu reimagines traditional Portuguese favourites such as bitoque, cod with cream, francesinha, duck-style rice and bifana, alongside homemade desserts. It is a comfortable place to explore vegan Portuguese cooking with your dog.

360.description: Inquieta, in Campolide, Lisbon, is an independent bookshop and café welcoming dogs indoors. Spread over two floors, it combines books from independent publishers with an entirely plant-based café serving toast, quiche, cakes, cookies, coffee and tea. It is a quiet, welcoming place to read or take a break with your dog in Lisbon.

362.description: A Lanchonete in Belém, on Rua Pinto Ferreira in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on the terrace, with biscuits for pets. The family-rooted, Brazilian-inspired menu includes brunch, pão de queijo, tapioca, açaí, burgers and savoury pastries. It is a relaxed stop for a meal with your dog, within reach of walks along the Tagus River.

363.description: A Lanchonete (Benfica), listed in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace and offers them biscuits. The Brazilian-inspired menu includes brunch, pão de queijo, tapioca, açaí, burgers and savoury pastries. The original listing contains conflicting location details, so confirm the exact branch and address before visiting with your dog.

365.description: A Lanchonete Parede, on Avenida da República in Parede, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace, with biscuits for four-legged visitors. Its Brazilian-inspired menu includes pão de queijo, coxinhas, fried pastries, burgers, brunch and feijoada on selected days. Located in Parede’s traditional shopping area on the Cascais railway line, it is an inviting stop with your dog throughout the year.

366.description: Atelier d’A Lanchonete, on Avenida da Ilha da Madeira in Restelo, Lisbon, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on the terrace, with biscuits available for pets. Part café and part creative workshop for the brand, it serves Brazilian favourites such as pão de queijo, savoury pastries and açaí, alongside cakes, brunch and coffee roasted on site. The small space has seating indoors and outside.

367.description: Farmácia Penha de França, on Avenida Coronel Eduardo Galhardo in Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors and provides water for them. Alongside dispensing medicines, the pharmacy offers health services such as nutrition and podiatry appointments, vaccinations, basic health checks and pharmaceutical advice. Its extended opening hours make it a convenient place to run essential errands with your dog in Penha de França.

368.description: Brant Parque das Nações, on Rua Cais das Naus in Lisbon, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace and provides water for them. Open throughout the day, it serves breakfast and brunch dishes such as sandwiches, wraps, eggs, croissants, bowls and coffee drinks. The nearby Tagus waterfront and walking paths make it easy to combine a meal or coffee break with a stroll with your dog.

369.description: Good Company Books, in Avenidas Novas, Lisbon, is a bookshop and café welcoming dogs indoors. Specialising in English-language books, it offers international literature and translated Portuguese-language works in a space designed for reading, working or meeting friends. The café serves locally roasted speciality coffee, pastries and small bites, while Portuguese wine by the glass is available later in the day. A distinctive dog-friendly stop for book lovers in Lisbon.

370.description: Parque Canino de Sacavém, in the Quinta do Património development in Sacavém, is a fenced dog park of approximately 400 m² where dogs can exercise and play off-lead. The enclosure has training equipment, a drinking fountain, benches and waste bins. Created by the local parish authorities, it provides a dedicated place for dog exercise and socialisation near Lisbon.

377.description: Faz Frio, in Príncipe Real, Lisbon, allows dogs indoors, although the restaurant is small and does not prominently advertise its pet policy. With more than a century of history, it specialises in traditional Portuguese cooking, including bacalhau à Zé do Pipo, cod fritters, alheira croquettes, fried green beans and pica-pau. It is an atmospheric option for a meal with your dog in central Lisbon; checking ahead may be helpful given the limited space.

378.description: Santa Clara dos Cogumelos, on the upper floor of Mercado de Santa Clara in Lisbon, welcomes dogs. Close to the Feira da Ladra flea market, the restaurant specialises in dishes built around mushrooms, from starters to desserts, including wild and cultivated varieties, risotto, small plates and vegetarian options. With an informal setting and views towards the Tagus, it offers an unusual dining stop with your dog while exploring São Vicente and Alfama.

380.description: Pizzaria Massa Fina in Lourinhã welcomes dogs both indoors and on its terrace. The owners make an effort to accommodate visitors with dogs, including adjusting seating or arranging an outdoor table when possible. Known for its thin-crust pizzas, the small, family-run restaurant offers a variety of toppings and vegetarian options. It is a friendly choice for a relaxed meal with your dog in Lourinhã.

383.description: EPOCA – Osteria Italiana, in Parque das Nações, Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace, with water available for pets. Close to the Tagus River and Vasco da Gama Tower, the restaurant serves traditional Italian family recipes, fresh pasta, homemade desserts and Italian wines. The nearby riverside promenade makes it easy to combine a meal with a walk with your dog.

386.description: Kong – Food Made With Compassion, on Rua do Corpo Santo in Lisbon’s Cais do Sodré area, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and often has biscuits for four-legged visitors. There is no terrace. The entirely plant-based menu offers vegan versions of Portuguese favourites, including bitoque, francesinha, cod-style fritters, fried cuttlefish-style dishes and feijoada, as well as house-made desserts. Its animal-friendly philosophy makes it a particularly fitting stop with your dog in Lisbon.

389.description: Pão do Rogil, in Rogil in the municipality of Aljezur, welcomes dogs on its terraces. This artisan bakery on the Vicentine Coast makes bread, cakes and biscuits inspired by regional flavours, including Aljezur sweet potatoes, carob and almonds. The menu also includes toasties, sandwiches, pies, focaccia, savoury croissants and ice cream. Its several outdoor terraces make it a convenient place to stop with your dog while exploring the Vicentine Coast.

390.description: MÁDÁ in Sítio de Santa Susana, Aljezur, is a dog-friendly restaurant that welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace, with water available for them. The steakhouse and bar focuses on cuts of meat and relaxed meals made for sharing. The restaurant confirms that pets are welcome as long as its rules and other guests' comfort are respected. Its position beside the EN120 makes it a convenient stop when travelling through Aljezur with your dog.

391.description: Balagan Ericeira, at Praia do Sul in Ericeira, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. Its Mediterranean cuisine draws strongly on Middle Eastern flavours, seasonal ingredients and vegan and gluten-free options. The venue includes a café and deli downstairs and a rooftop restaurant overlooking the Atlantic, serving breakfast, lunch, dinner and cocktails. It is a relaxed, sea-view restaurant for dining with your dog in Ericeira.

393.description: The Cascais seafront promenade, known as the Paredão de Cascais, is an approximately three-kilometre coastal walking route between Cascais and São João do Estoril. Dogs may accompany walkers when properly registered and kept on a lead, with a muzzle where legally required. Owners must clean up after their pets. Beaches, cafés and sea views along the way make it a popular place for a walk with your dog on the Cascais and Estoril coast.

394.description: Palácio Baldaya in Benfica, Lisbon, welcomes dogs on the café terrace and in the outdoor garden. Housed in a restored palace, this cultural venue brings together a library, children’s play area, coworking spaces, exhibitions and events, as well as a café with a leafy outdoor area. It is a relaxing place to take a break with your dog in Benfica while enjoying the garden or cultural surroundings.

396.description: Mahalo Restaurant & Bar in Santa Bárbara de Nexe, in the municipality of Faro, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. The relaxed restaurant combines Portuguese and Mediterranean food, with meat, fish, small plates, vegan options and cocktails. It has outdoor tables and a rooftop bar, and the restaurant explicitly allows pets. If you're looking for somewhere to eat with your dog in inland Algarve, you can choose indoor or outdoor seating.

397.description: Restaurante O Ténis in Portimão welcomes dogs on its terrace, which sits in a fenced outdoor area. Located beside the Municipal Tennis Complex, the restaurant serves traditional Algarve cuisine, including fresh fish, tapas-style dishes and charcoal-grilled specialities such as grilled sardines and cuttlefish. Its spacious terrace is a practical option for enjoying a meal outdoors with your dog in Portimão.

399.description: Honest Greens Chiado, on Rua Ivens in central Lisbon, accepts dogs, although it has not specified exactly which indoor or outdoor areas they may use. Near Praça Luís de Camões, the restaurant focuses on healthy food with seasonal ingredients, customisable dishes and vegetarian, vegan and keto choices. Contact the restaurant before visiting to confirm where your dog may stay.

400.description: Pastelaria Colibri II in Galé, Albufeira, welcomes dogs on its terrace, which has plenty of shade and water available for pets. Known for pastries, coffee, breakfast and light meals, it has several outdoor tables where you can take a comfortable break with your dog. Located near Galé Shopping Centre, close to the beaches and main roads in this part of Albufeira, it is a practical stop for breakfast, brunch or coffee during a walk around Galé.

401.description: Alma e Tejo, in the riverside linear park of Póvoa de Santa Iria, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace and provides water for them. Dogs must remain on a lead. Its position beside the Tagus River and nearby walking paths makes it an inviting spot for a meal or drink before or after a riverside walk with your dog.

402.description: The Praia da Adraga–Praia Grande boardwalk in Colares, near Sintra, crosses the protected Adraga–Praia Grande Ecological Park and offers a scenic walk with your dog between the hills and the Atlantic. Wooden boardwalks and marked paths pass through restored habitats, viewpoints and areas of geological and archaeological interest, with views of both beaches. To protect this sensitive landscape, keep your dog close and stay on the designated routes.

411.description: Catramóia Praia in Lourinhã is dog-friendly holiday accommodation where dogs can stay indoors with their owners and water is available for pets. The apartment offers a practical base for travelling with your dog near the coast, with opportunities for walks and seaside outings around Lourinhã.

420.description: Aldeia Museu José Franco, also known as Aldeia Típica José Franco, in Sobreiro near Mafra, welcomes dogs on a lead accompanied by their owners. This free-to-visit open-air village museum recreates traditional rural life in the Lisbon region through historic workshops, shops, windmills, miniature buildings, pottery and local crafts. It is a pleasant place to explore with your dog, and a bakery on site serves the region’s traditional chouriço bread.

422.description: Pena D’Água Boutique Hotel & Villas in Covilhã welcomes pets of any size, with up to three per room subject to confirmation. Pets may stay in the room and access the bar, reception and outdoor areas, including the poolside, but they cannot enter the pool. Bowls and pet beds are available on advance request. Pets are not allowed in the breakfast room, although alternatives are offered in the lounge bar or room. One pet is allowed in the Açafrão restaurant.

423.description: Vai… Vai Gerês, in the centre of Gerês village, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. Dogs must be kept on a lead throughout the visit. Being able to choose between indoor and outdoor seating makes it convenient at different times of year. It's a good place to stop for a drink, lunch or dinner before or after exploring the Gerês region with your dog.

424.description: Cantinho Redondo in Froufe, Ponte da Barca, is dog-friendly accommodation that accepts up to two dogs per stay, with no size restrictions or extra pet fee. The house is in Peneda-Gerês National Park, in a peaceful natural setting close to the river and small lagoons. It's a great base for exploring Gerês and enjoying outdoor walks and hikes with your dog.

425.description: Tanoa Café, in Lisbon’s Bairro Alto neighbourhood, welcomes dogs indoors regardless of size. There is no outdoor terrace, but dogs are welcome inside the café. The menu focuses on brunch, with eggs Benedict, pancakes, speciality coffee, matcha and other freshly prepared options. If you're looking for somewhere to stop with your dog in central Lisbon, it's a relaxed and welcoming choice.
